description: Fresh 24-case 12-month and 96-month matrices after the approved limited surrender rule, paired with the same scenario/faction/cohort seeds from the preserved pre-rule policy. Selected-faction outcomes are evaluated at each actual endpoint; early elimination shortens exposure. Capture, prisoner handling and changed terminal dates can affect later campaign evolution. These adjacent-bot outcomes do not establish human balance or acceptance. Four independent fixed-policy replays export validated monthly, battle-start and final saves; retained surrender events are not asserted to be a complete long-run event history.

assembly.note: 24 independent cases; original full-matrix seed indices, complete case coverage, immutable source, external harness and configuration verified. Parallel runtime totals are not performance measurements.

24 independently executed cases with original full-matrix seed indices. Source, external harness, model, configuration, unique case coverage and seeds verified before assembly. The common fingerprint describes the logical full matrix; per-case commands/config hashes and raw report hashes remain below. Parallel runtime totals are not performance measurements.
